lines.text: I had $1,000 sitting in cash — and no clue what to do with it. So I typed that exact sentence into an AI.
That's most of us, right? You want your money to grow — but "where do I even start" freezes you. So it just sits there.
Turns out there's now an AI built for your money. And you don't even need an idea — if you don't have one, it just asks you a few simple questions.
Here's the part that got me — I answered like three, and it built the whole thing. A real, rules-based strategy.
Then it showed me how it would have performed on actual past prices.
And I could paper-trade it on real prices — free — before risking a single dollar.
Comment "BUDDI" and I'll DM you the link to try it free.
